newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wo Kee Hong mulls joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Wo Kee Hong mulls joint venture.

text.p: Wo Kee Hong (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday a wholly-owned subsidiary had signed a letter of intent with Jinling Electrical Co to set up a joint venture plant in China's southern Guangdong province.
The joint venture plant in Jiangman in Guangdong province will involve an investment of about US$5.00 million to be borne equally by the two parties, the company said.
The joint venture plant will manufacture and distribute audio and visual equipment for the China market, it said.
Wo Kee Hong said the two parties would conduct a feasibility study of the joint venture.

The Jiangman-based Jinling Electrical is an existing joint venture partner of Wo Kee Hong's another plant which makes and distributes automatic washing machines and Mitsubishi brand air-conditioners, the company said. It gave no further details.
Wo Kee Hong shares closed HK$0.23, or 45.45 percent higher, at HK$0.80 on Wednesday.
